clips.title: The story
paras: Along Teldrassil’s western road, corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs threaten the route from Dolanaar to Darnassus. Moon Priestess Amara coordinates scouts and travelers to keep this trade and messenger road clear of ambushes.

You travel west from Dolanaar toward Darnassus on Teldrassil’s main overland road. Trade goods, political messages, and travelers use it each day to stay connected with the capital and the boughs of the great tree. Teldrassil is young and wild, so safe roads matter to its kaldorei communities.

The Gnarlpine furbolgs of Teldrassil have fallen to a foul corruption. Driven mad by a sickness plaguing the boughs of the World Tree, they attack from hidden dens beneath the ridges. Gnarlpine ambushers stalk the tree line beside the road, preying on couriers and travelers and making the forest passage deadly.

Moon Priestess Amara watches over the road outside Dolanaar. She joins the spiritual authority of Elune’s priesthood with the Sentinels’ vigilance, directing capable travelers to strike at ambushers near their dens below the road. The safety of the route to Darnassus’s gates depends on keeping them at bay.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The road to Darnassus must be kept safe. Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.
Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily. We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.
Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, adventurer. Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The road is still not safe, adventurer. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave hunter. As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
